ConnectionStrings.// DefaultConnection: Only required for Development mode tests and running with local container. n AWS Secrets Manager secret value

Jwt.// SigningKey: Only required for Development mode tests and running with local container. Production uses an AWS Secrets Manager secret value

AwsSecrets.// Enabled: Off by default so local development and the test suite never attempt an AWS call. Turned on in appsettings.Production.json, which is what's loaded when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT is Production.
